import html from typing import List # A simple template that will be used to render the post. # The placeholders are named for readability and can be # replaced with str.format or f-strings. USER_POST_FORMAT: str = """

{post_heading}

Posted by: {user_name}

{post_content}
{post_tags}
""" def build_post_html( user_name: str, post_heading: str, post_content: str, post_tags: List[str] ) -> str: """ Generate a safe HTML representation of a forum post. All user-provided input is escaped to prevent XSS attacks. Tags are rendered as individual elements. Parameters ---------- user_name : str The author of the post. post_heading : str The title of the user's post. post_content : str The main content of the user's post. post_tags : List[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str The sanitized HTML string for the post. """ # Escape all user input to avoid injection escaped_user_name = html.escape(user_name, quote=True) escaped_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) escaped_content = html.escape(post_content, quote=False) # Build tags string: each tag wrapped in a with escaped content escaped_tags = [ f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in post_tags ] tags_html = " ".join(escaped_tags) # Populate the template html_output = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( post_heading=escaped_heading, user_name=escaped_user_name, post_content=escaped_content, post_tags=tags_html ) return html_output.strip()
